original_audit.original_report: Original installation-local audit retained outside distribution; no environment data copied.

findings.root_cause: Scope aliases were compared as raw strings; integration trusted branch-controlled paths and rename destinations.
findings.changes: Canonical ownership frozen at prepare; traversal/escape and rebinding rejected; every rename endpoint checked; lexical paths and resolved symlink targets both checked; exact reviewed checkout bound through QA.
findings.residual_risk: Case aliases are conservatively serialized; worktrees are not process sandboxes.

findings.root_cause: CLI always returned zero after runner result.
findings.changes: Propagate runner exit/signal; missing configuration and runner fail; keyboard interruption returns 130.
findings.residual_risk: Runner output remains diagnostic; smoke coverage is limited.

findings.root_cause: Unconditional broad staging captured unrelated work.
findings.changes: Exact files, explicitly reviewed index or initial source inventory; bind index and HEAD across QA; credential checks shared.
findings.residual_risk: Prepared index selection is a human/coordinator assertion; failed gate mutations remain for inspection.

findings.root_cause: Audit iterated only old selected entries and lost optional selectors.
findings.changes: Retain selectors; compare complete selected name sets, missing content, hashes, stack and recorded sources/revisions.
findings.residual_risk: Registry metadata and hashes do not authenticate suppliers.

findings.root_cause: Copied downloaded skills without their runtimes made installed fixtures falsely appear ready.
findings.changes: Exclude runtime and external skills; create isolated deterministic installer fixtures and source inventory.
findings.residual_risk: Offline lifecycle simulation mocks external downloads; real bounded dependency checks are separate.

findings.root_cause: Pre-discovery expectations read mutable destination configuration.
findings.changes: Move state-dependent checks into fixtures; exercise core, React, Python, combined and security configurations.
findings.residual_risk: Representative stacks; no claim every framework/version is tested.

findings.root_cause: Empty prepare accessed absent packets key.
findings.changes: Return zero packets/prepared tasks without creating runtime files.
findings.residual_risk: Prepare still requires product documentation approval.

findings.root_cause: iPhone descriptor required WebKit but instructions installed Chromium.
findings.changes: Use Pixel 7 Chromium with Desktop Chrome and local browser cache.
findings.residual_risk: Synthetic application smoke does not validate a future product.

findings.root_cause: Single-value regex leaked quoted, bearer and multiline output.
findings.changes: Discard authentication-bearing subprocess output; recognize flags/credential URIs; atomic 0600 logs and 0700 directory.
findings.residual_risk: Unknown/obfuscated credentials cannot be ruled out; authentication diagnostics are intentionally suppressed.

findings.root_cause: Root-specific filename comparisons missed nested credentials.
findings.changes: Shared basename/component policy at any depth, with explicit non-secret example suffixes.
findings.residual_risk: Example suffix exemption is filename-only; content remains scanned.

findings.root_cause: Ready status stood in for review and QA could cover another commit/tree.
findings.changes: Record reviewer/result/exact commit/time/evidence/findings; reject stale/nonindependent review; bind checkout and require integrated reviewed commit before completion QA.
findings.residual_risk: Reviewer identity and evidence are procedural attestations, not authenticated proof.

findings.root_cause: Bare package names and mutable repository sources allowed silent upstream drift.
findings.changes: Exact npm versions and integrity locks via npm ci; Python release hashes; immutable skill source references; writable runtime paths and executables confined to project; isolated package-manager routing; provenance/update policy.
findings.regression: test_remediation_devops.py; bounded real dependency install checks
findings.residual_risk: Full supplier code/advisory/legal audit and all-platform/optional installs are not complete; installed tool binaries are not version-attested automatically; generator repository HEAD is not package-build attestation.

findings.root_cause: Narrow patterns skipped token families/history and deduplicated historical pathnames.
findings.changes: Scan tracked/export content and every historical tree pathname plus reachable blobs; reject runtime/downloaded skills; dedicated Gitleaks run separately.
findings.residual_risk: Heuristic scans cover reachable local history only and cannot certify absence of secrets.

findings.root_cause: Blocked tasks had no supported outgoing recovery transition.
findings.changes: Explicit evidence-bearing blocked-to-todo resume preserves history and clears stale review.

findings.root_cause: Locale regex only accepted basic language and uppercase region.
findings.changes: Document and validate common BCP47 language/script/region/variant subset; conversation language separate.
findings.residual_risk: Extensions, private-use and full registry canonicalization are deliberately unsupported.

findings.root_cause: Actions tags/images latest and known development password defaults were mutable/unsafe.
findings.changes: Verified action SHAs; require explicitly reviewed image digest variables and development passwords; localhost ports remain explicit.
findings.residual_risk: Image digests/compatibility must be selected and verified by project; no service was started; hosted Actions/OS matrix untested.
